Healing, combat drugs and armor: player/NPC parity

2026-10-26 · Actual packaged game execution · Java 17, headless.

9189 checks passed: 49 consumable profiles and 97 armor/clothing entries, all eight quality levels, both actor types. The encounter matrix contains 1,280 resolved fights and repeats exactly.

Healing now restores real health, not just condition labels. Supported drugs alter derived combat values for a bounded duration, refuse same-family stacking, expire once and apply their crash. Both actors use the same armor coverage/quality rules. NPCs consume finite carried stock and spend an action using it.

What testing found

  • Medical Use reduced counters without repairing player body damage; most combat drugs only printed catalog text. Shared support execution now restores health/conditions and applies timed effects.
  • Legacy clothing equip replaced quality-bearing item identities with Common names. The original identity and quality now survive equip.
  • NPC attacks used abstract equipment tier while players used actual weapon quality. Equal gear, quality and skill now yield equal attack effects.
  • Helmets, gauntlets and boots apply only to their actual coverage. A helmet cannot protect a torso, gloves cannot protect upper arms, and boots cannot protect thighs.
  • Finite stock, one-action use, physical player item-instance consumption, NPC/player effect persistence, expiry, non-stacking and no resurrection are checked.
  • Coffee tin, Stim vial and Stimulant ampoule now perform their declared sleep/debt reduction and strain effects. Reusable tools and unsupported narcotics are not swallowed as medicine.

Watch fights with supplies

Blue A = Guard, orange B = Cultist, white diamond = observer. Every frame is a recorded turn. Green bars show HP; amber outlines indicate active drug effects. Hover a participant for loaded rounds and remaining carried supplies. This is an omniscient replay of game state, not a separate combat simulator.



Randomized encounter results
Two weapon modes × eight supply conditions × four sizes (1v1, 5v5, 10v10, 20v20) × ten seeds × two mirrored starting sides = 1,280 cases, each capped at 180 turns. Each selected actor receives one Medkit and/or one Street Stimm. Armor conditions use Common suppression armor plus a flak helmet. Controls have the same weapons/skills/HP and no support stock or armor.

Interpretation: protection is powerful against knives, while the current rifle penetration ignores this Common armor. Medkits demonstrably restore HP, but spending an action on treatment can lose a firing race. Drug bonuses are measurable; their use timing and crash still need balancing. These are controlled execution observations, not final win-rate or balance certification.


Try it in the developer room
/devroom match 5 rifles 71000
/devroom support A Medkit
/devroom support B Street Stimm
/devroom armor A Guard flak vest
/devroom armor A Guard flak helmet
/devroom watch
Use /devroom step 1 for single turns and /devroom combatstats for actual healing, dose and attack counters. The combat console also has supply and armor buttons. Normal player inventory Use/equip actions run the same support/armor rules. NPC supplies survive save/load and do not regenerate during inspection.


Validation and limits
Normal client/server Maven packages pass. Both JARs pass archive integrity and base-class Java 17 checks; separate LWJGL version-directory classes are recorded in the JSON report. The registry and encounter tests ran directly from the packaged client, without diagnostic class overrides.

  • Effect magnitudes, armor ratings/coverage and NPC use thresholds are initial tuning, not approved final balance.
  • Supported field-use medicines, combat drugs, starting stimulants, recaf and labor stimulants are active. Other narcotics, surgical tools, psychic, addiction and withdrawal effects remain outside this pass; unsupported items are not consumed as fake treatment.
  • NPCs use abstract HP plus condition state; players use existing body-part health and condition fields. Finite NPC supplies are seeded for new appropriate roles and persisted; old saves do not gain free replacement stock.
  • Common flak/riot protection is fully penetrated by the current rifle profile. Knife protection and location-specific worn gear are verified; rifle armor balance still needs review.
  • Healing spends a combat action and is not a guaranteed survival increase; rifle medkit groups can lose more often despite measurable healing.
  • Armor uses the best covering layer, not additive stacking of all inventory goods. Damage/quality/coverage tests do not certify every weapon type, shield, augmetic, disease or full injury/loot presentation.
  • The paper-doll body-region UI failure is the same pre-existing failure recorded in the prior build. Full Gate3 and release certification were not run.
  • An additional broad world-size generation/persistence sweep was interrupted during large-world generation; it is not counted as passed.
  • Headless packaged execution only. Installed PACKAGE_client distribution was not replaced.
